name: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the prepress, printing, bookbinding, and related ancillary businesses in Japan. It operates through Information Communication, Information Security, Living and Industrial Materials, and Other segments. The company engages in the planning and production of weekly, monthly, and quarterly magazines. It also offers paperbacks, collected works, textbooks, posters, calendars, advertising and promotional materials, decorative displays, and electronic books, as well as periodicals, books, general commercial printings, digital and in-store media, and digital communication services.
